definitions.explanation: A craftsman of outstanding skill, especially one whose name is known for their work in swords, carpentry, pottery, carving, and similar crafts.

examples.japanese: {名工|めいこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧。
examples.english: A sword made by a master craftsman.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{彫刻|ちょうこく}→彫刻：04448_choukoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸時代|えどじだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名工|めいこう}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧ものだ。
examples.english: The carvings in this temple are the work of a master craftsman of the Edo period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧、⟦{優|すぐ}れた→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧⟦{技能|ぎのう}→技能：12801_ginou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧「⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名工|めいこう}」⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{表彰|ひょうしょう}→表彰：17400_hyoushou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Every year the government honors people with outstanding skills as "Contemporary Master Craftsmen."

notes:
A written, somewhat formal word of praise.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名工|めいこう}: "Contemporary Master Craftsman", a national award for skilled workers
- {名工|めいこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧: a work by a master craftsman

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧: craftsman, artisan (neutral, any level of skill)
- {匠|たくみ}: master artisan (literary, popular in advertising)
- ⟦{名人|めいじん}→名人：03753_meijin⟧: master of any skill, including games and arts

WATCH OUT:
Same reading as ⟦{名校|めいこう}→名校：21195_meikou⟧ (a famous school).
